_note: BOSS 动作表设计锁：look/weapon/glow 来自立绘总览 + theme-boss-unique 原型/标志物表；atk/cast 对应现有六招体系，用于让攻击帧与施法帧匹配技能。

tb_swamp_maw.look: hunched swamp beast, barrel body half sunk in mud, a huge vertical circular maw ringed with crooked teeth filling the chest, bog-green and mud-brown hide, tangled vines and reed strands hanging off the back
tb_swamp_maw.weapon: no weapon, the maw itself and two clawed forelimbs
tb_swamp_maw.glow: murky yellow-green glow from deep inside the maw
tb_swamp_maw.atk: lunging forward and snapping the giant maw shut
tb_swamp_maw.cast: gagging, then spewing a burst of mud and writhing vines from the maw

tb_acid_mother.look: bloated acid mother, four short splayed legs around a sagging translucent belly sac full of bright green liquid, small low-set head with a long dripping tongue, acid-eaten carapace plates and tubes on the back
tb_acid_mother.weapon: no weapon, dripping acid from every limb
tb_acid_mother.glow: sickly lime-green light glowing through the belly sac
tb_acid_mother.atk: raising both forelimbs and slamming the belly down, spraying acid
tb_acid_mother.cast: arching back and vomiting a wide stream of green acid upward

tb_proto_mind.look: prototype mind, an oversized pink brain suspended in a cracked glass jar, steel clamps and lens rings around the jar, thin cable legs and two thin manipulator arms, small sensor array on top
tb_proto_mind.weapon: two thin telescoping manipulator arms tipped with probe needles
tb_proto_mind.glow: cyan-blue light pulsating inside the jar
tb_proto_mind.atk: thrusting both probe arms forward in a fast double stab
tb_proto_mind.cast: jar rings spinning, cable arms raised, brain flaring with cyan arcs

tb_prime_core.look: prime core, tall pale-white humanoid frame with teal light seams, a huge round reactor core set into the chest, a second smaller core floating above the shoulder, smooth ceramic plating and exposed cable bundles
tb_prime_core.weapon: no weapon, both palms open as emitters
tb_prime_core.glow: bright mint-teal core light in the chest and palm emitters
tb_prime_core.atk: driving a straight palm thrust with the chest core surging
tb_prime_core.cast: both arms spread wide, twin cores splitting apart and flaring teal

tb_observer.look: alien observer, slender pale-blue elongated body, long neck and oversized smooth tapering head, one huge black lens eye, thin ribbed limbs, a floating observation ring orbiting behind the shoulders
tb_observer.weapon: no weapon, the ring floats beside it
tb_observer.glow: ice-blue light around the floating ring and the single eye
tb_observer.atk: sweeping a thin scanning beam from the eye ring across the ground
tb_observer.cast: raising both arms, the ring spinning fast and opening into a vertical abduction portal

tb_curator.look: the curator, gaunt tall human in a long tan trench-coat and wide-brimmed hat, bandaged hands, a specimen jar strapped to the hip, a lean vulture-like posture
tb_curator.weapon: a long silver display hook in one hand and a capped specimen jar in the other
tb_curator.glow: amber glow from the jar of preserved specimens
tb_curator.atk: stepping in and swinging the display hook in a wide downward arc
tb_curator.cast: holding up the specimen jar, amber light spilling out to form a summoning circle

tb_arsenal_sergeant.look: arsenal sergeant, broad armored soldier in olive and sand plate armor, oversized pauldrons, bandolier of shells across the chest, a heavy ammo backpack, helmet with a narrow visor slit
tb_arsenal_sergeant.weapon: a huge belt-fed drum cannon carried two-handed
tb_arsenal_sergeant.glow: orange muzzle heat and a red targeting dot on the helmet
tb_arsenal_sergeant.atk: shouldering the drum cannon and firing a heavy burst
tb_arsenal_sergeant.cast: slamming a fresh drum magazine home and racks of shells rising behind him

tb_scrap_warlord.look: scrap warlord, a six-legged scrap crawler chassis welded from car parts and armor plates, a small warlord welded into an open cockpit on top, exhaust stacks and a magnet fork rack on the back
tb_scrap_warlord.weapon: a huge two-pronged scrap magnet fork on a winch arm
tb_scrap_warlord.glow: rust-orange sparks from weld seams and a dirty yellow cockpit lamp
tb_scrap_warlord.atk: stomping forward on six legs and driving the magnet fork down
tb_scrap_warlord.cast: craning the magnet fork up, scrap debris lifting and orbiting the fork

tb_bridge_raider.look: bridge raider, wiry human in a torn orange jumpsuit with rope harness and spiked shoulder strap, gas-mask goggles, a coil of chain over one shoulder, bandaged forearms
tb_bridge_raider.weapon: a heavy boat hook on a chain, plus a length of pipe
tb_bridge_raider.atk: lassoing the hook forward and yanking it back
tb_bridge_raider.cast: swinging the chain overhead and slamming it into the ground to call a raider camp

tb_bunker_commander.look: bunker commander, stocky soldier in grey-green bunker armor, tank-tread greaves, heavy helmet with a periscope visor, ammo belts wrapped across the chest, a field radio on the back
tb_bunker_commander.weapon: a long service rifle with an underslung launcher
tb_bunker_commander.atk: kneeling slightly and firing a precise rifle shot
tb_bunker_commander.cast: raising a flare pistol and calling an artillery grid on the radio

tb_castle_tyrant.look: hollow throne tyrant, towering armored knight in blackened iron with dull gold trim, a jagged crown fused into the helm, castle battlement stone grown over one shoulder, a tattered crimson cape
tb_castle_tyrant.weapon: a long royal greatsword held in both gauntlets
tb_castle_tyrant.glow: crimson light in the crown and the helm's eye slits
tb_castle_tyrant.atk: raising the greatsword overhead and cleaving straight down
tb_castle_tyrant.cast: planting the sword point-down, a crimson ring of royal light spreading out

tb_bell_bishop.look: bell bishop, figure entirely wrapped in a bell-shaped bronze and dark-wood robe, a tall pointed mitre, a heavy broken bronze bell growing out of the back, long sleeves hiding the hands
tb_bell_bishop.weapon: a long-handled censer swinging on a chain
tb_bell_bishop.glow: amber ember light inside the censer and a crack in the bell
tb_bell_bishop.atk: swinging the censer in a wide horizontal arc
tb_bell_bishop.cast: raising both arms, the broken bell tolling and amber sound rings expanding

tb_mine_foreman.look: mine foreman, thick mutant miner with a hunched back, soot-black and dust-brown hide, a hard hat with a failing headlamp, hydraulic drill rig bolted to one arm, rib cage of coal lumps
tb_mine_foreman.weapon: a giant industrial drill mounted on the right arm
tb_mine_foreman.glow: a warm yellow headlamp beam and red drill heat
tb_mine_foreman.atk: revving the drill and lunging forward with it
tb_mine_foreman.cast: slamming the drill into the ground, rock spikes erupting around him

tb_flood_colossus.look: flood colossus, massive stone-and-concrete dam golem, cracked masonry hide covered in moss and dripping water, a rusted ship's wheel embedded in the chest, rebar spikes, no visible head, three small silt eyes on the shoulder mound
tb_flood_colossus.weapon: no weapon, two enormous stone fists
tb_flood_colossus.glow: cold teal light leaking through the chest cracks
tb_flood_colossus.atk: raising both fists overhead and slamming them down
tb_flood_colossus.cast: planting both feet, water bursting from the chest and a surge wave rolling forward

tb_fog_wraith.look: fog wraith, tall gaunt pale ghost woman in a long ragged white shroud, long black hair floating, hollow dark eyes, thin arms, mist trailing from the hem
tb_fog_wraith.weapon: a small rusted fog lantern hanging from one hand
tb_fog_wraith.atk: reaching out with one long arm, fingers spread, mist claws forming
tb_fog_wraith.cast: raising the lantern, thick fog pouring out and hiding the body

tb_dockmaster.look: the dockmaster, huge barrel-chested bearded human in a stained apron and flat cap, rolled sleeves, rope belt, rubber boots, a pipe in his mouth
tb_dockmaster.weapon: a long gaff hook in one hand and a coil of mooring chain in the other
tb_dockmaster.glow: a dull teal glow from a lantern hooked to his belt
tb_dockmaster.atk: stomping in and swinging the gaff hook in a hooking arc
tb_dockmaster.cast: hurling the mooring chain forward, chain links whipping across the ground

tb_drydock_rig.look: drydock rig, heavy blue-grey gantry walker on four hydraulic legs, a boxy work deck as a torso, a winch drum on the back, a crane gantry arm over one shoulder, riveted plating
tb_drydock_rig.weapon: a heavy winch crane arm with a hook block
tb_drydock_rig.glow: pale cyan work lights on the deck
tb_drydock_rig.atk: swinging the crane arm down like a wrecking weight
tb_drydock_rig.cast: spinning the winch drum, cables whipping out and anchors dropping

tb_gravity_eye.look: gravity eye, a giant blue iris eyeball floating inside a broken ring of carved ancient stone, orbiting rock chunks circling slowly, stone crown shards floating above, no limbs
tb_gravity_eye.glow: bright cyan iris light and a violet gravity halo
tb_gravity_eye.atk: the eye narrowing, stone chunks flung forward as a volley
tb_gravity_eye.cast: the eye opening wide, a violet gravity well collapsing in front of it

tb_grey_harbor.look: grey harbour crane, an industrial harbour crane on two heavy legs, a revolving column torso, two asymmetric booms, a ring of harbour bells at the centre, a small driver cabin, grey-blue steel
tb_grey_harbor.weapon: the twin booms themselves, tipped with hook and counterweight
tb_grey_harbor.glow: a pale yellow cabin lamp and the bell ring
tb_grey_harbor.atk: swinging both booms down together in a pincer slam
tb_grey_harbor.cast: the harbour bell ring tolling, pale yellow sound rings rolling forward

tb_highway_king.look: highway king, a leather-clad human fused into a one-wheeled motorcycle chariot, huge spoked wheel under him, red bandana and spiked visor, exhaust pipes over the shoulders, chain belts, a fur collar
tb_highway_king.weapon: a motorized chain-flail held over the wheel
tb_highway_king.glow: red tail-light glow from the engine block and visor
tb_highway_king.atk: revving the wheel and doing a fast forward charge
tb_highway_king.cast: cracking the chain-flail, exhaust jets blasting from the back

tb_hotel_nightmare.look: the guest of room 13, a whole walking hotel facade: brick wall body with lit windows, a red-curtained doorway as a mouth, a brass room-number plate, gargoyle heads on the shoulders, roof signage on top
tb_hotel_nightmare.weapon: no weapon, two stone gargoyle arms
tb_hotel_nightmare.glow: warm red-orange light from the windows and the doorway mouth
tb_hotel_nightmare.atk: the doorway swinging open and a swarm of room keys shooting out
tb_hotel_nightmare.cast: the facade opening up, red curtains spilling out and a room corridor unfolding

tb_hotel_clerk.look: night clerk, elegant pale ghost in a purple hotel uniform with gold piping, high collar, slicked hair, hollow eyes, long coattails, a small bell on the glove
tb_hotel_clerk.weapon: a brass service bell in one hand and a room key ring in the other
tb_hotel_clerk.glow: violet glow from the uniform piping and the bell
tb_hotel_clerk.atk: ringing the service bell and lunging with the key ring
tb_hotel_clerk.cast: raising the bell, violet light opening ghost room doors around him

tb_strait_howler.look: strait howler, blue-white quadruped sea beast, sleek wet hide, a long seal-like neck, a wide mouth full of needle tusks, ragged fin frills along the spine, bone flute hanging at the throat
tb_strait_howler.glow: pale blue bioluminescent dots along the spine
tb_strait_howler.atk: crouching and lunging forward with a tusk bite
tb_strait_howler.cast: throwing its head back and howling, blue sound rings blasting forward

tb_librarian.look: the librarian, tall robed archivist in faded gold and parchment-white, four slender arms, a brass reading lamp for a head with a single lens, floating pages and book spines orbiting the body
tb_librarian.weapon: a heavy iron book-binding clamp in one hand
tb_librarian.glow: warm amber lamp light from the head lens and floating pages
tb_librarian.atk: swinging the binding clamp down while pages slash forward
tb_librarian.cast: all four arms raised, orbiting pages forming a spinning spiral

tb_lighthouse_keeper.look: the lighthouse keeper, stooped human in a heavy navy keeper's coat and wool cap, glowing rotating lantern room grown where the head should be, brass fittings and glass panes, oil-stained gloves
tb_lighthouse_keeper.weapon: a long brass lamp hook in one hand
tb_lighthouse_keeper.glow: bright golden beam light from the head lantern
tb_lighthouse_keeper.atk: swinging the lamp hook forward in a wide arc
tb_lighthouse_keeper.cast: the head lantern rotating fast, a golden searchlight beam sweeping the arena

tb_iron_colonel.look: iron colonel, tall officer in a blood-red greatcoat with gold epaulettes and a chest full of medals, peaked cap, half his lower body replaced by a tracked tank base, a sabre at the hip
tb_iron_colonel.weapon: an engraved officer's pistol and a sabre
tb_iron_colonel.glow: red signal glow from the cap badge and shell casings
tb_iron_colonel.atk: snapping the sabre forward in a precise thrust
tb_iron_colonel.cast: raising the pistol and calling an artillery grid with a whistle

tb_reactor_priest.look: reactor priest, tall figure in a heavy white and pale-green radiation robe, a lead-lined hood with a blank gold mask, glowing fuel rod bundles forming a halo behind the shoulders, rubber gloves
tb_reactor_priest.weapon: a long censer on a chain radiating green light
tb_reactor_priest.glow: sickly green fuel-rod halo and censer
tb_reactor_priest.atk: swinging the glowing censer forward in a wide arc
tb_reactor_priest.cast: both arms raised, the fuel rod halo flaring and green radiation rings pulsing out

tb_paper_press.look: press roller III, a squat industrial printing press machine, two massive brown steel rollers as a torso, rows of gear teeth, a paper feed slot like a mouth, ink-stained plates, stubby piston legs
tb_paper_press.glow: faint amber glow from the ink plates
tb_paper_press.atk: lunging and crushing forward between the spinning rollers
tb_paper_press.cast: the rollers spinning up, sheets of paper and ink spraying out

tb_warden.look: the warden, broad human jailer in grey riot armor with a faceless steel helmet, keys and shackles hanging from the belt, a heavy shield plate on one arm, heavy boots
tb_warden.weapon: a pump shotgun in one hand and a ring of prison keys in the other
tb_warden.glow: a dull white lamp on the helmet and a red alarm light on the chest
tb_warden.atk: bracing the shield and firing the shotgun point blank
tb_warden.cast: slamming the key ring down, iron cell bars erupting from the ground

tb_punk_amp.look: distortion amp, angular black punk mech, a stack of four speaker cabinets for a torso, spiked mohawk crest and riveted skull faceplate, cable dreadlocks, one arm ending in a guitar-neck blade
tb_punk_amp.weapon: a guitar-neck blade and a microphone-flail
tb_punk_amp.glow: hot magenta light from the speaker cones and mohawk
tb_punk_amp.atk: swinging the guitar-neck blade down in a power chord slam
tb_punk_amp.cast: speaker cones blasting, magenta sound rings rolling forward

tb_rad_colossus.look: radiation colossus, hulking green-glowing mutant giant, lumpy tumorous hide, a rusted yellow radiation trefoil plate bolted to the chest, exposed glowing ribs, one arm much larger than the other
tb_rad_colossus.glow: acid-green light from the exposed ribs and the trefoil plate
tb_rad_colossus.atk: swinging the oversized arm down in a heavy smash
tb_rad_colossus.cast: roaring, green radiation rings pulsing out from the chest

tb_red_tide.look: red tide mother, a bloated crimson tide creature, a bulbous coral-encrusted body with a ring of waving red tentacles, foam skirt along the base, a buoy tangled in the tentacles, barnacle plates
tb_red_tide.glow: red-orange light pulsing inside the coral body
tb_red_tide.atk: lashing a bundle of tentacles forward in a whip strike
tb_red_tide.cast: all tentacles raised, a red tide surge rolling out along the ground

tb_caregiver.look: broken caregiver, a rounded white enamel care pod on four rubber wheels, big glass dome front showing a dim patient silhouette, a red cross on the roof, six thin nursing arms hanging from the sides, an IV pole with bags
tb_caregiver.weapon: six thin nursing arms tipped with syringes, clamps and bottles
tb_caregiver.glow: soft pale-green light from the dome and IV bags
tb_caregiver.atk: lunging forward and stabbing with a bundle of syringes
tb_caregiver.cast: dome glowing, warm green light pouring out and nursing arms raised

tb_assembly_overseer.look: assembly overseer iron jaw, heavy factory mech in dark gunmetal with orange-hot seams, a wide wedge jaw full of steel teeth, a crane hook rig over one shoulder, piston-driven legs, riveted plates
tb_assembly_overseer.weapon: a huge assembly crane hook on a chain
tb_assembly_overseer.glow: orange furnace light in the jaw and chest seams
tb_assembly_overseer.atk: stepping in and swinging the crane hook down
tb_assembly_overseer.cast: beating both fists like a metronome, orange rings pulsing and conveyor sparks rising

tb_rally_boss.look: rally horn, a tall broadcast tower walking on three splayed legs, a truss mast body, four stacked loudspeaker discs facing different directions, a small operator cabin in the middle, an aviation lamp on top
tb_rally_boss.glow: blue-white light from the aviation lamp and speaker cones
tb_rally_boss.atk: leaning forward and blasting a cone of blue-white sound
tb_rally_boss.cast: all four speakers flaring, blue-white rings expanding and summoning signal flags

tb_rot_queen.look: rot queen, tall fungus-rotted queen, a mottled green and ochre body like decaying wood, a crown of curling roots and mushrooms, a vine-wrapped throne growing out of her back, clusters of ripe pods hanging from her arms
tb_rot_queen.glow: jaundiced yellow-green glow from the hanging pods
tb_rot_queen.atk: swinging the thorned vine whip forward
tb_rot_queen.cast: arms raised, pods bursting and spore clouds blooming

tb_schoolmaster.look: the schoolmaster, gaunt tall human in a worn brown suit with a waistcoat and high collar, round spectacles, hair in a tight bun, a blackboard strapped to his back, chalk dust on his sleeves
tb_schoolmaster.weapon: a long wooden ruler and a heavy chalk eraser
tb_schoolmaster.glow: pale white chalk light on the blackboard
tb_schoolmaster.atk: swinging the wooden ruler down like a cane strike
tb_schoolmaster.cast: throwing the eraser, chalk-white rings and summoned blackboard barriers unfolding

tb_shadow_walker.look: shadow walker, extremely thin black blade-limbed figure, a shell of overlapping dark plates, no face only a horizontal glowing eye slit, four folded knife legs, spiked shoulders, ribbon-like shadow bands trailing from the back
tb_shadow_walker.weapon: both arms end in long folded shadow blades
tb_shadow_walker.glow: violet light in the thin eye slit and the blade edges
tb_shadow_walker.atk: lunging low and slashing with both shadow blades
tb_shadow_walker.cast: folding into a crouch, violet shadow ribbons swirling and blades multiplying

tb_shipwright.look: the shipwright, burly riveted mech in blue-grey shipyard steel, a welder's mask face with one bright lens, a massive rivet hammer arm, an oxy-torch on the other arm, a keel-frame rig on the back
tb_shipwright.weapon: a giant rivet hammer and an oxy-torch nozzle
tb_shipwright.glow: blue-white welding arc light from the torch
tb_shipwright.atk: swinging the rivet hammer in a heavy overhead blow
tb_shipwright.cast: the oxy-torch flaring, a keel frame rising and welding sparks spraying

tb_skyline_baron.look: skyline baron, lopsided nobleman in a gold-trimmed green uniform and tall top hat, one enormous armored mech arm with a tower-crane counterweight, one shrunken thin arm with a pincer, a fur collar

tb_skyline_baron.glow: gold monocle light and a green glow from the giant arm's vents

tb_orbit_judge.look: orbit judge, tall slender figure in a white and pale-blue orbital pressure suit, a smooth reflective helmet with a narrow visor, a big orbital ring floating behind the shoulders, thin thruster boots, a judge's gavel
tb_orbit_judge.glow: cold white-blue visor light and a ring of blue thruster glow
tb_orbit_judge.atk: raising the gavel and slamming it down
tb_orbit_judge.cast: spreading both arms, the orbital ring spinning and dropping a falling debris column

tb_arena_champion.look: arena champion, huge rust-and-bronze gladiator brute, horned helmet with an iron cage faceplate, massively wide shoulders with riveted plate armor, thick shackled legs, a tattered red champion sash
tb_arena_champion.weapon: a spiked cestus fist and a short heavy cleaver
tb_arena_champion.glow: orange glow in the helmet's eye cage
tb_arena_champion.atk: stepping in and throwing a huge spiked haymaker
tb_arena_champion.cast: beating the chest, the arena bell ringing and orange rings bursting out

tb_substation.glow: bright electric blue arcs crawling over the coil body

tb_professor.weapon: a heavy pointer rod and a rack of volatile test tubes
